details: Hey-o! I’m Ivan Kazuya. I’ve been playing VRChat since late October. I’ve had the opportunity to meet VRPill, Tupper, Gunter, some devs, members from Loli Squad, and many other VRC celebs. I mostly make videos for youtube. I also have made worlds and not-so-often I make avatars. At this point VRChat is a lifestyle to me. I was wondering, for players deeply embedded in this social VR world, if it would be a good idea to make an official documentary. A documentary that explains the history, technical hurdles, and behind the scenes culture of VRChat. It would also be great to know more about the game’s developers and how much they have contributed to making this game a reality. Another interesting idea would be to interview VR celebs like members from Loli Squad and other popular creative players and world designers (like Big Al (my opinion one of the first major avatar creators); Kawaii Force; the not-so-famous anymore Kanna Gang; the makers and culture of the Ugandan knuckles; and perhaps root gentle for his realistic looking worlds). I think this would help players learn or familiarize people behind the makers of VRChat. I also think a detailed long documentary would create even more value for VRChat. Anyhow, that’s my idea. Be sure to add me in the credits. Thank you.
title: Official VRChat Documentary
